prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Three adult friends aged 29, 33, and 40 prepare dinner in a modest bright kitchen: one chops vegetables safely on a board, one rinses tomatoes, and one sets plain plates on the counter. They talk without looking at the camera. Use warm early-evening window light, believable kitchen details, and a candid medium-wide composition. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances for exactly three people: a 29-year-old woman with a short ash-blond bob safely chops vegetables; a 33-year-old man with dark tight curls and a lean build rinses tomatoes; a 40-year-old broad-shouldered man with ginger stubble and short copper hair sets plates. Keep knife and fingers visibly separate and anatomically plausible.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
Critical scale requirement: make a VERY WIDE ESTABLISHING PHOTOGRAPH from about eight metres away with a 35mm lens, rather than a medium group shot. Keep the entire closely gathered group, ALL heads, ALL bodies, every limb and key prop inside x=28% through x=72% of frame width. The leftmost and rightmost quarters contain only environment, never people. All people must be visibly smaller within the generous surrounding scenery. Use a full coherent optical photograph, no blends or masked areas.
review: Reviewed replacement full wide image: exactly three distinct adults prepare food in a complete bright kitchen, a dark-curly-haired man at the sink, a short-haired woman chopping in the middle and a ginger man setting plates. Visible hands connect plausibly, the knife stays separate from fingers, and central grouping survives both required crops. Horizontal 1672x941.
